connector.name: Cure Cancer With AI

connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hifarrer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
